expect.says: The welcome card of the empty starter offers Start with a small square beside Start building.
Pressing it asks what the square is to the person, offering each role the Create panel offers, and writes nothing.
Choosing the role opens a confirmation stating the server's preview of the square, and Confirm is offered only once that preview is ready; nothing is written before Confirm.
Each confirmed press of Take back the last change removes one object from the objects panel, until it lists none, and the welcome card does not come back.
The apply adds every object the preview named, each as its own add edit with the chosen role, and the saved world resumes at that version.
The version then gains one undo edit per object, each naming the newest add not yet taken back, and holds no live object.

model_right_offers.notice: Exulanica's depth model (MoGe-2, a fixed version) will estimate the 3D shape of what each selected photo shows. It runs inside Exulanica's own processing; the photo is not sent to an outside AI service for this step. People you chose to hide are hidden before the model sees the photo. The result is an estimate from one photo: sizes and distances are approximate, and it shows only what the camera saw. It appears in a world only where you place it. You can stop this at any time: no new estimates are made and existing estimates stop being shown in your worlds.

The people in the photo are not hidden from this model: it is the model that finds them, so that Exulanica can hide them in what it builds. The model is MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3, or when that one is unavailable, openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4_5. stand_ins.statement: The human review of the rehearsal's photographs is given by the rehearsal driver, through the photo drawer's own controls, under the run's synthetic account. The photographs are synthetic drawings with no people in them. This review stands in for a person's review; it is not one, and no person inspected these photographs.

steps.action: In the world made from the photographs, upload one more synthetic photograph in the drawer, admit it, review it as the stand-in states, and wait for its work. Read the drawer's offer; press Add my new photographs as places and read the preview; press Cancel once; press it again, wait for Confirm: add them as places to wake, press it and let the world reopen; read the drawer's offer again.

After Confirm the world reopens under its title, every object it held is listed, and no object note or status line says that an object names a region the world does not draw.

stand_ins.statement: The human review of the rehearsal's photographs is given by the rehearsal driver, through the photo drawer's own controls, under the run's synthetic account. The photographs are synthetic drawings with no people in them. This review stands in for a person's review; it is not one, and no person inspected these photographs.

steps.action: Turn the admitted photographs into scene geometry, inspect its coverage and open it inside the world with the authored changes kept.

expect.says: The reconstructed geometry opens in the world beside the authored changes, with its actual coverage shown.

steps.owner_area: scene reconstruction: docs/capabilities/scene-reconstruction.md and the scene jobs
steps.reason: What this rehearsal runs, and what it cannot. It runs main's production derivative worker with its depth model (runtime.derivative_worker: MoGe-2 on this machine's CPU), which makes a point map of each reviewed photograph, and the scene grouping that closes each job; wait-for-depth-and-grouping observes both, and a made world draws each photograph from its point map. It does not run multi-view reconstruction. Scene grouping selects a group for pose recovery only when it holds at least three photographs, each with a point map (SceneGroupPosePolicy in exulanica/ingest/scene_selection.py), and the rehearsal's drawings are a day apart, so each is its own group and no scene job exists. The scene worker (exulanica-scene-worker) also requires the pose runtime image by digest as provenance (exulanica/ingest/scene_worker_command.py), and this machine builds no image, so it cannot be started here with a truthful record; Gaussian training needs GPU compute this machine does not have. No control in the application shows a scene's coverage.
